summary:

An extraordinarily cinematic 1970s action-movie car chase combining the gritty realism of Bullitt, The French Connection, and classic New Hollywood filmmaking with the impossible camera movements and bullet-time cinematography of The Matrix.

Barack Obama drives a black Dodge Charger through 1974 Chicago while Donald Trump pursues him in a red Mustang.

The sequence features rapid changes between interior close-ups, wheel-level tracking shots, aerial helicopter cinematography, hood-mounted cameras, and impossible high-speed camera movements.

Authentic 35mm anamorphic cinematography, Kodak film grain, warm vintage color grading, practical stunt driving, realistic vehicle physics, aggressive film editing, and enormous cinematic scale.

detailed_description:

[Shot 1: 0.000s]

EXTREME AERIAL HELICOPTER SHOT.

A breathtaking high-altitude view of downtown Chicago in 1974.

The camera dives rapidly toward an intersection beneath elevated train tracks.

A BLACK DODGE CHARGER rockets through the intersection.

A RED MUSTANG follows dangerously close behind.

Both cars weave between period-correct traffic.

The camera plunges toward the speeding vehicles in one continuous aerial movement.

[Shot 2: 2.500s]

HARD CUT — INTERIOR CHARGER.

Extreme close-up of {Barack Obama_BC} behind the wheel.

Golden sunlight flashes across his aviator sunglasses as buildings streak past the windows.

He calmly shifts gears.

{Barack Obama_BC} says, <d>[English]You really wanna do this?</d>

His foot slams the accelerator.

[Shot 3: 4.500s]

HARD CUT — WHEEL-LEVEL SIDE TRACKING.

The Charger's rear tire spins violently.

The camera races alongside the black car inches above the asphalt.

The rear suspension compresses as Obama powerslides around a sharp corner.

Tires scream.

The red Mustang enters the frame behind him, following the same trajectory.

[Shot 4: 7.000s]

HARD CUT — INTERIOR MUSTANG.

A tight, vibrating dashboard-mounted shot of {Donald Trump_BC} gripping the steering wheel.

His blond hair moves in the wind from the open window.

He leans forward aggressively.

{Donald Trump_BC} says, <d>[English]Nobody outruns me! NOBODY!</d>

He violently downshifts.

[Shot 5: 9.000s]

HARD CUT — HIGH-SPEED FRONT TRACKING SHOT.

Both muscle cars charge directly toward the camera beneath the elevated railway.

The camera retreats at matching speed.

An elevated train thunders overhead.

Dust, sparks, and loose newspaper pages explode through the air.

The Mustang closes the distance to the Charger's rear bumper.

[Shot 6: 11.500s]

HARD CUT — ULTRA-WIDE AERIAL.

A helicopter camera sweeps sideways above the Chicago River.

The two cars race along a narrow industrial road beside the water.

The Mustang attempts to overtake the Charger.

Obama swerves slightly, blocking the pass.

The camera performs an enormous sweeping aerial arc as both cars disappear beneath a steel bridge.

CUT ON THE SOUND OF A GUNSHOT.

overall_soundscape:

Deafening vintage V8 engines, mechanical gear changes, screaming tires, rattling suspension, elevated trains, distant police sirens, wind buffeting the microphones, and authentic 1970s automobile sounds.

Dialogue is clear but naturally mixed against the roaring engines.

Aggressive cinematic sound design emphasizes every gear shift, tire impact, and rapid camera transition.

non_diegetic_music:

A powerful 1970s action-thriller soundtrack combining wah-wah electric guitar, aggressive funk bass, live drums, brass stabs, orchestral strings, and pounding cinematic percussion.

Music inspired by the gritty energy of classic 1970s crime thrillers.

The rhythm accelerates with the chase.

A dramatic orchestral impact accompanies the final gunshot.

summary:

A spectacular continuation of the 1970s Chicago car chase.

The sequence opens with Donald Trump firing a revolver from his speeding Mustang.

The camera performs an impossible Matrix-style transition, following the bullet from directly behind as it travels through the air toward Barack Obama's Charger.

The bullet spins through suspended dust and flying debris before striking the Charger's side mirror.

Obama reacts with an aggressive evasive maneuver, launching into an extraordinary practical-stunt car chase beneath Chicago's elevated train tracks.

The sequence combines gritty 1970s cinematography with revolutionary bullet-time effects, dramatic aerial shots, violent vehicle dynamics, and breathtaking editorial transitions.

detailed_description:

[Shot 1: 0.000s]

EXTREME CLOSE-UP — INTERIOR RED MUSTANG.

{Donald Trump_BC} drives aggressively with one hand.

He raises a chrome revolver with his other hand, pointing it out the open driver's window toward the black Charger ahead.

A dramatic low-angle close-up captures his furious expression.

He fires ONE SHOT.

A gigantic orange muzzle flash illuminates his face.

[Shot 2: 2.000s]

IMPOSSIBLE BULLET-FOLLOW CAMERA.

HARD CUT DIRECTLY BEHIND THE FIRED BULLET.

The camera follows the spinning metallic projectile from only inches behind its base.

The bullet fills the center of the frame.

Its copper surface rotates rapidly, reflecting golden sunlight.

The background stretches into dramatic motion blur.

The red Mustang recedes behind the camera while the black Charger grows larger directly ahead.

The bullet travels forward in a physically consistent trajectory.

[Shot 3: 4.000s]

MATRIX-STYLE BULLET TIME.

Time appears to slow dramatically.

The camera performs an impossible 180-degree orbit around the spinning bullet while maintaining its forward trajectory.

Individual dust particles hang in the air.

Tiny droplets of water and floating newspaper fragments drift past the projectile.

The bullet's polished surface reflects the surrounding Chicago buildings.

The camera completes the orbit and returns DIRECTLY BEHIND THE BULLET.

[Shot 4: 6.500s]

EXTREME BULLET-FOLLOW IMPACT SHOT.

The bullet races toward the black Charger's driver's-side mirror.

The camera accelerates directly behind it.

The projectile strikes the chrome side mirror.

GLASS EXPLODES INTO HUNDREDS OF FRAGMENTS.

The camera passes through the cloud of shattered glass in an impossible high-speed movement.

Each fragment reflects the golden Chicago skyline.

No person is struck.

[Shot 5: 8.500s]

HARD CUT — INTERIOR BLACK CHARGER.

A violently shaking dashboard-mounted close-up of {Barack Obama_BC}.

The shattered mirror flashes past his window.

Obama ducks instinctively, then looks forward with intense concentration.

{Barack Obama_BC} says, <d>[English]Oh, now you've done it.</d>

He yanks the steering wheel.

[Shot 6: 10.500s]

HARD CUT — LOW EXTERIOR SIDE TRACKING.

The black Charger violently changes direction.

Its rear tires break traction.

The entire car slides sideways through a narrow intersection.

The suspension compresses dramatically as the tires regain grip.

The red Mustang follows, narrowly missing a parked 1970s taxi.

Sparks scatter from the Mustang's undercarriage as it scrapes the pavement.

[Shot 7: 12.500s]

HARD CUT — SPECTACULAR AERIAL HELICOPTER SHOT.

The camera rises rapidly above the elevated train tracks.

Below, the black Charger and red Mustang race side by side through a narrow industrial corridor.

A train roars overhead.

The Charger accelerates ahead, disappearing into a tunnel beneath the railway.

The Mustang follows into the darkness.

The helicopter camera continues rising, revealing the enormous 1974 Chicago skyline glowing in the sunset.

The final image is a vast cinematic aerial composition.

CUT TO BLACK AT 15 SECONDS.

overall_soundscape:

An enormous revolver gunshot, metallic bullet whistling, dramatic air displacement, shattering glass, roaring V8 engines, tire squeals, grinding metal, rapid gear changes, suspension impacts, and elevated train noise.

During the bullet-follow sequence, environmental audio becomes heavily filtered and stretched, emphasizing the projectile's movement.

At impact, full-speed sound returns with an explosive glass-shattering effect.

All vehicle movement maintains realistic physical momentum.

non_diegetic_music:

A monumental fusion of gritty 1970s action cinema and modern cinematic orchestration.

Opening:

Aggressive wah-wah guitar, funky electric bass, and live percussion.

Bullet-follow sequence:

The music drops into an enormous low-frequency synthesizer drone, ticking percussion, and slowly rising orchestral strings.

Bullet impact:

A thunderous orchestral BRAAAM and explosive percussion hit.

Final chase:

The full 1970s funk-action soundtrack returns with pounding drums, brass stabs, distorted guitar, and rapid string ostinatos.

The final aerial shot concludes with a massive sustained brass chord and abrupt silence.

import re

text = input_text

# [Shot 1: 0s] -> [Shot 1]

text = re.sub(

    r'\[Shot\s+(\d+):\s*0(?:\.0+)?s\]',

    r'[Shot \1]',

    text,

    flags=re.IGNORECASE

)

# [Shot 5: 6.8s] -> [Shot 5] At 00:06.800,

# Works for Shot 2, Shot 3, Shot 4, etc.

def convert_shot(match):

    shot = match.group(1)

    seconds = float(match.group(2))

    return f'[Shot {shot}] At 00:{seconds:06.3f},'

text = re.sub(

    r'\[Shot\s+(\d+):\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)s\]',

    convert_shot,

    text,

    flags=re.IGNORECASE

)

result = text
